fusions.name: Woven Net
fusions.desc: Throws a net of stings at a target up to 6 tiles away for 12 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. It stuns for 1 second, slows by 25% for 3 seconds and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Smothering Folds
fusions.desc: Throws a smothering fold 4 tiles ahead of you that deals 28 poison damage to everything in it, ignoring resistances, and leaves them [Muddled], casting slower, for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Honeyed Dressing
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to the ally who needs it most, for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Keeper's Garb
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 8%, and you have 12% poison resistance.
